translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Wang Mang had an usher read the empress dowager's edict at the gate to dismiss Xian, saying, "Xian is young and inexperienced; as Grand Marshal he does not accord with popular sentiment—surrender the Grand Marshal's seal and cord and retire to your residence!

sentences.zh: 」即日，賢與妻皆自殺；

translations.literal: " That same day Xian and his wife both committed suicide;
translations.idiomatic: " That same day Xian and his wife both committed suicide;

sentences.zh: 家惶恐，夜葬。

translations.literal: the family in panic buried him by night.
translations.idiomatic: the family, in panic, buried him by night.

sentences.zh: 莽疑其詐死。

translations.literal: Mang suspected a feigned death.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang suspected a feigned death.

sentences.zh: 有司奏請發賢棺，至獄診視，因埋獄中。

translations.literal: The responsible officials memorialized to open Xian's coffin, examine the corpse in prison, and bury it there.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible officials memorialized to open Xian's coffin, examine the corpse in prison, and bury it there.

sentences.zh: 太皇太后詔「公卿舉可大司馬者」。

translations.literal: The grand empress dowager issued an edict: "Let the Three Dukes and ministers nominate one fit to be Grand Marshal."
translations.idiomatic: The grand empress dowager issued an edict: "Let the high ministers nominate one fit to be Grand Marshal."

sentences.zh: 莽故大司馬，辭位避丁、傅，眾庶稱以為賢，又太皇太后近親，自大司徒孔光以下，舉朝皆舉莽。

translations.literal: Mang had formerly been Grand Marshal and resigned his post to avoid the Ding and Fu clans; the common people praised him as worthy, and as a close kinsman of the grand empress dowager—from Grand Minister of Education Kong Guang down—the whole court nominated Mang.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang had formerly been Grand Marshal and resigned to avoid the Ding and Fu clans; the people praised him as worthy, and as a close kinswoman of the grand empress dowager—from Grand Minister of Education Kong Guang down—the whole court nominated Wang Mang.

sentences.zh: 獨前將軍何武、左將軍公孫祿二人相與謀，以為「往時惠、昭之世，外戚呂、霍、上官持權，幾危社稷；

translations.literal: Only Forward General He Wu and Left General Gongsun Lu two men counseled together, holding that "in the times of Emperors Hui and Zhao, maternal kin—the Lü, Huo, and Shangguan—held power and nearly endangered the altars of state;
translations.idiomatic: Only Forward General He Wu and Left General Gongsun Lu counseled together, holding that "in the times of Emperors Hui and Zhao, maternal kin—the Lü, Huo, and Shangguan—held power and nearly endangered the state;

sentences.zh: 今孝成、孝哀比世無嗣，方當選立近親幼主，不宜令外戚大臣持權。

translations.literal: "now Emperors Xiaocheng and Xia'ai in succession left no heir; it is just the time to select and establish a close kinsman as a young lord—it is not fitting to let maternal kin and great ministers hold power.
translations.idiomatic: "now Emperors Xiaocheng and Xia'ai in succession left no heir; it is time to select a close kinsman as a young sovereign—it is not fitting to let maternal kin and great ministers hold power.

sentences.zh: 親疏相錯，為國計便。

translations.literal: Let near and distant be interlaced—this is convenient for the state's plan."
translations.idiomatic: Let near and distant be interlaced—this serves the state's interest."

sentences.zh: 」於是武舉公孫祿可大司馬，而祿亦舉武。

translations.literal: " Thereupon Wu nominated Gongsun Lu as fit for Grand Marshal, and Lu likewise nominated Wu.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon Wu nominated Gongsun Lu for Grand Marshal, and Lu likewise nominated Wu.

sentences.zh: 庚申，太皇太后自用莽為大司馬、領尚書事。

translations.literal: On gengshen the grand empress dowager herself appointed Mang Grand Marshal and head of Masters of Writing affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen the grand empress dowager herself appointed Wang Mang Grand Marshal and head of Masters of Writing affairs.

sentences.zh: 太皇太后與莽議立嗣。

translations.literal: The grand empress dowager and Mang deliberated on establishing an heir.
translations.idiomatic: The grand empress dowager and Wang Mang deliberated on establishing an heir.

sentences.zh: 安陽侯王舜，莽之從弟，其人修飭，太皇太后所信愛也，莽白以舜為車騎將軍。

translations.literal: Marquis of Anyang Wang Shun, Mang's younger cousin of the same clan, was a man of cultivated deportment whom the grand empress dowager trusted and loved; Mang reported to have Shun made Commandant of Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: Marquis of Anyang Wang Shun, Wang Mang's younger cousin, was a man of cultivated deportment whom the grand empress dowager trusted and loved; Wang Mang had Shun appointed Commandant of Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 秋，七月，遣舜與大鴻臚左咸使持節迎中山王箕子以為嗣。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, she sent Shun with Grand Herald Zuo Xian, bearing credentials, to welcome the King of Zhongshan's son Jizi as heir.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, she sent Shun with Grand Herald Zuo Xian, bearing credentials, to welcome the King of Zhongshan's son Jizi as heir.

sentences.zh: 莽又白太皇太后，詔有司以皇太后前與女弟昭儀專寵錮寢，殘滅繼嗣，貶為孝成皇后，徙居北宮。

translations.literal: Mang again reported to the grand empress dowager; an edict charged the responsible officials that the empress dowager had formerly monopolized favor with her younger sister the Brilliant Companion, destroying the succession, and demoted her to Empress of Emperor Xiaocheng, moving her to the North Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang again reported to the grand empress dowager; an edict charged that the empress dowager had formerly monopolized favor with her younger sister the Brilliant Companion, destroying the succession, and demoted her to Empress of Emperor Xiaocheng, moving her to the North Palace.

sentences.zh: 又以定陶共王太后與孔鄉侯晏同心合謀，背恩忘本，專恣不軌，徙孝哀皇后退就桂宮，傅氏、丁氏皆免官爵歸故郡，傅晏將妻子徙合浦。

translations.literal: Moreover, because the grand empress dowager of the King of Dingtao and Marquis of Kongxiang Yan had joined hearts in conspiracy, turned their backs on grace and forgot their roots, and acted willfully beyond the norm, Empress of Emperor Xia'ai was moved back to Gui Palace; the Fu and Ding clans were all stripped of office and rank and returned to their home commanderies, and Fu Yan took wife and children to exile in Hepu.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, because the grand empress dowager of the King of Dingtao and Marquis of Kongxiang Yan had conspired together, turned their backs on grace and forgot their roots, and acted willfully beyond the norm, Empress of Emperor Xia'ai was moved back to Gui Palace; the Fu and Ding clans were all stripped of office and rank and returned to their home commanderies, and Fu Yan took wife and children to exile in Hepu.

sentences.zh: 獨下詔褒揚傅喜曰：「高武侯喜，姿性端愨，論議忠直，雖與故定陶太后有屬，終不順指從邪，介然守節，以故斥逐就國。

translations.literal: Alone an edict praised Fu Xi, saying: "Marquis of Gaowu Fu Xi—his bearing is upright and sincere, his discourse loyal and straight; though he had kinship with the former grand empress dowager of Dingtao, in the end he would not follow cues and join the wicked, but stood apart in guarding integrity, and for this was driven out to his state.
translations.idiomatic: Alone an edict praised Fu Xi, saying, "Marquis of Gaowu Fu Xi—his bearing is upright and sincere, his discourse loyal and straight; though he had kinship with the former grand empress dowager of Dingtao, in the end he would not follow cues and join the wicked, but stood apart in guarding integrity, and for this was driven out to his state.

sentences.zh: 《傳》不雲乎：『歲寒然後知松柏之後凋也。

translations.literal: Does not the Analects say: 'Only when the year grows cold do we know that the pine and cypress are the last to wither.
translations.idiomatic: Does not the Analects say, 'Only when the year grows cold do we know that the pine and cypress are the last to wither.

sentences.zh: 』其還喜長安，位特進，奉朝請。

translations.literal: ' Let Xi return to Chang'an, with rank as Special Advancement and attendance at court audiences."
translations.idiomatic: ' Let Xi return to Chang'an, with rank as Special Advancement and attendance at court audiences."

sentences.zh: 」喜雖外見褒賞，孤立憂懼；

translations.literal: " Though Xi outwardly received praise and reward, he stood alone in worry and fear;
translations.idiomatic: " Though Xi outwardly received praise and reward, he stood alone in worry and fear;

sentences.zh: 後復遣就國，以壽終。

translations.literal: later he was again sent to his state and died of old age.
translations.idiomatic: later he was again sent to his state and died of old age.

sentences.zh: 莽又貶傅太后號為定陶共王母，丁太后號曰丁姬。

translations.literal: Mang further demoted Grand Empress Dowager Fu's title to Mother of the King of Dingtao and Grand Empress Dowager Ding's title to Lady Ding.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang further demoted Grand Empress Dowager Fu's title to Mother of the King of Dingtao and Grand Empress Dowager Ding's title to Lady Ding.

sentences.zh: 莽又奏董賢父子驕恣奢僭，請收沒入財物縣官，諸以賢為官者皆免。

translations.literal: Mang also memorialized that Dong Xian father and son were arrogant, willful, extravagant, and overstepping, requesting confiscation of their goods for the state treasury, and that all who had held office through Xian be dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang also memorialized that Dong Xian father and son were arrogant, willful, extravagant, and overstepping, requesting confiscation of their goods for the state treasury, and that all who had held office through Xian be dismissed.

sentences.zh: 父恭、弟寬信與家屬徙合浦，母別歸故郡巨鹿。

translations.literal: His father Gong, younger brother Kuanxin, and household were exiled to Hepu; his mother separately returned to her home commandery Julu.
translations.idiomatic: His father Gong, younger brother Kuanxin, and household were exiled to Hepu; his mother separately returned to her home commandery Julu.

sentences.zh: 長安中小民歡嘩，鄉其第哭，幾獲盜之。

translations.literal: The petty people of Chang'an rejoiced and clamored, went to his residence to weep, and nearly seized his goods as loot.
translations.idiomatic: The common people of Chang'an rejoiced and clamored, went to his residence to weep, and nearly seized his goods as loot.

sentences.zh: 縣官斥賣董氏財，凡四十三萬萬。

translations.literal: The state treasury sold off the Dong clan's property, in all forty-three ten-thousands of ten-thousands.
translations.idiomatic: The state treasury sold off the Dong clan's property, totaling four hundred thirty million cash.

sentences.zh: 賢所厚吏沛朱詡自劾去大司馬府，買棺衣，收賢屍葬之。

translations.literal: An official whom Xian had favored, Zhu Xu of Pei, impeached himself and left the Grand Marshal's office, bought coffin and shroud, collected Xian's corpse, and buried him.
translations.idiomatic: An official whom Xian had favored, Zhu Xu of Pei, impeached himself and left the Grand Marshal's office, bought coffin and shroud, collected Xian's corpse, and buried him.

sentences.zh: 莽聞之，以它罪擊殺詡。

translations.literal: Mang heard of it and had Xu beaten to death on another charge.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang heard of it and had Xu beaten to death on another charge.

sentences.zh: 莽以大司徒孔光名儒，相三主，太后所敬，天下信之，於是盛尊事光，引光女婿甄邯為侍中、奉車都尉。

translations.literal: Mang, because Grand Minister of Education Kong Guang was a famed Confucian who had served three lords, was revered by the empress dowager, and was trusted by all under Heaven, thereupon greatly honored Guang and brought in Guang's son-in-law Zhen Han as Attendant-in-Ordinary and Commandant Who Conducts the Carriages.
translations.idiomatic: Because Grand Minister of Education Kong Guang was a famed Confucian who had served three sovereigns, was revered by the empress dowager, and was trusted throughout the realm, Wang Mang greatly honored Guang and brought in Guang's son-in-law Zhen Han as Attendant-in-Ordinary and Commandant Who Conducts the Carriages.

sentences.zh: 諸素所不說者，莽皆傅致其罪，為請奏草，令邯持與光，以太后指風光。

translations.literal: All whom he had long disliked, Mang piled on their crimes, drafted memorials of request, had Han carry them to Guang, and by the empress dowager's intent gave Guang a hint.
translations.idiomatic: All whom he had long disliked, Wang Mang piled on their crimes, drafted memorials, had Han carry them to Guang, and by the empress dowager's intent gave Guang a hint.

sentences.zh: 光素畏慎，不敢不上之；

translations.literal: Guang was by nature fearful and cautious and dared not fail to submit them;
translations.idiomatic: Guang was by nature fearful and cautious and dared not fail to submit them;

sentences.zh: 莽白太后，輒可其奏。

translations.literal: Mang reported to the empress dowager, and she always approved the memorials.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang reported to the empress dowager, and she always approved the memorials.

sentences.zh: 於是劾奏何武、公孫祿互相稱舉，皆免官，武就國。

translations.literal: Thereupon he impeached He Wu and Gongsun Lu for mutually nominating each other; both were dismissed from office, and Wu returned to his state.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he impeached He Wu and Gongsun Lu for mutually nominating each other; both were dismissed from office, and Wu returned to his state.

sentences.zh: 又奏董宏子高昌侯武父為佞邪，奪爵。

translations.literal: He also memorialized that Dong Hong's son Marquis of Gaochang Wu's father had been fawning and wicked, and stripped the rank.
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized that Dong Hong's son Marquis of Gaochang Wu's father had been fawning and wicked, and stripped the rank.

sentences.zh: 又奏南郡太守毋將隆前為冀州牧，治中山馮太后獄，冤陷無辜，關內侯張由誣告骨肉，中太僕史立、泰山太守丁玄陷人入大辟，河內太守趙昌譖害鄭崇，幸逢赦令，皆不宜處位在中土，免為庶人，徙合浦。

translations.literal: He also memorialized that Nanyang Administrator Wujiang Long, when formerly Governor of Jizhou, handled the prison case of the grand empress dowager of Zhongshan Feng and wrongfully trapped the guiltless; Marquis Within the Passes Zhang You falsely accused kin; Palace Steward Shi Li and Taishan Administrator Ding Xuan trapped men into capital punishment; Henei Administrator Zhao Chang slandered Zheng Chong—they had all luckily met amnesty edicts, yet none ought to hold position in the central lands; they were dismissed as commoners and exiled to Hepu.
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized that Nanyang Administrator Wujiang Long, when formerly Governor of Jizhou, handled the prison case of Grand Empress Dowager Feng of Zhongshan and wrongfully trapped the guiltless; Marquis Within the Passes Zhang You falsely accused kin; Palace Steward Shi Li and Taishan Administrator Ding Xuan trapped men into capital punishment; Henei Administrator Zhao Chang slandered Zheng Chong—they had all luckily met amnesty edicts, yet none ought to hold position in the central lands; they were dismissed as commoners and exiled to Hepu.

sentences.zh: 中山之獄，本立、玄自典考之，但與隆連名奏事；

translations.literal: In the Zhongshan prison case, Li and Xuan had themselves directed the examinations; Long had only joined his name in the memorial;
translations.idiomatic: In the Zhongshan prison case, Li and Xuan had themselves directed the examinations; Long had only joined his name in the memorial;

sentences.zh: 莽少時慕與隆交，隆不甚附，故因事擠之。

translations.literal: Mang in youth had admired and sought friendship with Long, but Long did not greatly attach himself—therefore Mang used the affair to squeeze him out.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang in youth had admired and sought friendship with Long, but Long did not greatly attach himself—therefore Wang Mang used the affair to squeeze him out.

sentences.zh: 紅陽侯立，太后親弟，雖不居位，莽以諸父內敬憚之，畏立從容言太后，令己不得肆意，復令光奏立罪惡：「前知定陵侯淳于長犯大逆罪，多受其賂，為言誤朝。

translations.literal: Marquis of Hongyang Li, the empress dowager's uterine younger brother, though he held no office, Mang inwardly respected and feared him as an elder uncle of the clan, fearing that Li might speak at ease to the empress dowager and prevent his acting as he pleased; he again had Guang memorialize Li's crimes: "He formerly knew that Marquis of Dingling Chunyu Chang had committed the great-rebellion crime yet received many bribes from him and spoke on his behalf, misleading the court.
translations.idiomatic: Marquis of Hongyang Li, the empress dowager's uterine younger brother, though he held no office, Wang Mang inwardly respected and feared him as an elder uncle of the clan, fearing that Li might speak at ease to the empress dowager and prevent his acting as he pleased; he again had Guang memorialize Li's crimes: "He formerly knew that Marquis of Dingling Chunyu Chang had committed treason yet received many bribes from him and spoke on his behalf, misleading the court.

sentences.zh: 後白以官婢楊寄私子為皇子，眾言曰：『呂氏少帝復出。

translations.literal: Later he reported that a palace slave woman Yang Ji had a private son made crown prince; the multitude said: 'The Young Emperor of the Lü clan has come forth again.
translations.idiomatic: Later he reported that a palace slave woman Yang Ji had a private son made crown prince; the multitude said, 'The Young Emperor of the Lü clan has come forth again.

sentences.zh: 』紛紛為天下所疑，難以示來世，成襁褓之功。

translations.literal: ' The clamor made him an object of doubt throughout all under Heaven; it is hard to show posterity and accomplish the merit of swaddling-clothes infancy.
translations.idiomatic: ' The clamor made him an object of doubt throughout the realm; it is hard to show posterity and accomplish the merit of nurturing an infant sovereign.

sentences.zh: 請遣立就國。

translations.literal: I request that Li be sent to his state."
translations.idiomatic: I request that Li be sent to his state."

sentences.zh: 」太后不聽。

translations.literal: " The empress dowager would not heed it.
translations.idiomatic: " The empress dowager would not heed it.

sentences.zh: 莽曰：「今漢家衰，比世無嗣，太后獨代幼主統政，誠可畏懼。

translations.literal: Mang said: "Now the House of Han declines; in succession there is no heir; the empress dowager alone acts for the young lord in governing the state—this is truly something to fear.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang said, "Now the House of Han declines; in succession there is no heir; the empress dowager alone acts for the young sovereign in governing the state—this is truly something to fear.

sentences.zh: 力用公正先天下，尚恐不從；

translations.literal: Even if you exert fairness before all under Heaven, I still fear they will not follow;
translations.idiomatic: Even if you exert fairness before all under Heaven, I still fear they will not follow;

sentences.zh: 今以私恩逆大臣議，如此，群下傾邪，亂從此起。

translations.literal: now to go against the great ministers' counsel out of private grace—if it is like this, the ranks below will lean wicked and disorder will rise from it.
translations.idiomatic: now to go against the great ministers' counsel out of private grace—if it is like this, the ranks below will lean wicked and disorder will rise from it.

sentences.zh: 宜可且遣就國，安後復徵召之。

translations.literal: It is fitting for the time being to send him to his state; when all is secure afterward, summon him back."
translations.idiomatic: It is fitting for the time being to send him to his state; when all is secure afterward, summon him back."

sentences.zh: 」太后不得已，遣立就國。

translations.literal: " The empress dowager had no choice and sent Li to his state.
translations.idiomatic: " The empress dowager had no choice and sent Li to his state.

sentences.zh: 莽之所以脅持上下，皆此類也。

translations.literal: The means by which Mang coerced and controlled those above and below were all of this kind.
translations.idiomatic: The means by which Wang Mang coerced and controlled those above and below were all of this kind.

sentences.zh: 於是附順莽者拔擢，忤恨者誅滅，以王舜、王邑為腹心，甄豐、甄邯主擊斷，平晏領機事，劉秀典文章，孫建為爪牙。

translations.literal: Thereupon those who attached themselves and followed Mang were promoted; those who resisted in resentment were destroyed and extinguished; Wang Shun and Wang Yi were made his inner core, Zhen Feng and Zhen Han directed decisive strikes, Ping Yan oversaw secret affairs, Liu Xiu managed documents, and Sun Jian served as claws and teeth.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon those who attached themselves and followed Wang Mang were promoted; those who resisted in resentment were destroyed; Wang Shun and Wang Yi were made his inner core, Zhen Feng and Zhen Han directed decisive strikes, Ping Yan oversaw secret affairs, Liu Xiu managed documents, and Sun Jian served as claws and teeth.

sentences.zh: 豐子尋、秀子棻、涿郡崔發、南陽陳崇皆以材能幸於莽。

translations.literal: Feng's son Xun, Xiu's son Fen, Cui Fa of Zhuo Commandery, and Chen Chong of Nanyang—all by talent and ability found favor with Mang.
translations.idiomatic: Feng's son Xun, Xiu's son Fen, Cui Fa of Zhuo Commandery, and Chen Chong of Nanyang—all by talent and ability found favor with Wang Mang.

sentences.zh: 莽色厲而言方，欲有所為，微見風采，黨與承其指意而顯奏之。

translations.literal: Mang's countenance was stern while his words were upright; when he wished to act on something, he slightly showed a hint of intent, and his faction received his meaning and openly memorialized it.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang's countenance was stern while his words were upright; when he wished to act on something, he slightly showed a hint of intent, and his faction received his meaning and openly memorialized it.

sentences.zh: 莽稽首涕泣，固推讓，上以惑太后，下用示信於眾庶焉。

translations.literal: Mang kowtowed, wept, and firmly declined—above to confuse the empress dowager, below to show trustworthiness to the common people.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang kowtowed, wept, and firmly declined—above to sway the empress dowager, below to show trustworthiness to the common people.

sentences.zh: 八月，莽復白太皇太后，廢孝成皇后、孝哀皇后為庶人，就其園。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Mang again reported to the grand empress dowager to demote Empress of Emperor Xiaocheng and Empress of Emperor Xia'ai to commoners and send them to their mausoleum parks.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Wang Mang again reported to the grand empress dowager to demote Empress of Emperor Xiaocheng and Empress of Emperor Xia'ai to commoners and send them to their mausoleum parks.

sentences.zh: 是日，皆自殺。

translations.literal: That day both committed suicide.
translations.idiomatic: That day both committed suicide.

sentences.zh: 大司空彭宣以王莽專權，乃上書言：「三公鼎足承君；

translations.literal: Grand Minister of Works Peng Xuan, because Wang Mang monopolized power, thereupon submitted a memorial, saying: "The Three Dukes are like a tripod's legs bearing the lord;
translations.idiomatic: Grand Minister of Works Peng Xuan, because Wang Mang monopolized power, submitted a memorial, saying, "The Three Dukes are like a tripod's legs bearing the sovereign;

sentences.zh: 一足不任，則覆亂美實。

translations.literal: if one leg cannot bear its load, the tripod overturns and the fine substance is spoiled.
translations.idiomatic: if one leg cannot bear its load, the tripod overturns and the fine substance is spoiled.

sentences.zh: 臣資性淺薄，年齒老眊，數伏疾病，昏亂遺忘，願上大司空、長平侯印綬，乞骸骨歸鄉里，俟寘溝壑。

translations.literal: Your subject's nature is shallow and thin, my years and teeth are old and dim, repeatedly I fall ill, muddled and forgetful—I wish to surrender the Grand Minister of Works and Marquis of Changping's seal and cord, beg my old bones to return to my home village, and await placement in ditch and gully."
translations.idiomatic: Your subject's nature is shallow, my years are old and dim, I am repeatedly ill, muddled and forgetful—I wish to surrender the Grand Minister of Works and Marquis of Changping's seal and cord, beg my old bones to return home, and await burial in ditch and gully."

sentences.zh: 」莽白太后策免宣，使就國。

translations.literal: " Mang reported to the empress dowager to dismiss Xuan by edict and send him to his state.
translations.idiomatic: " Wang Mang reported to the empress dowager to dismiss Xuan by edict and send him to his state.

sentences.zh: 莽恨宣求退，故不賜黃金、安車、駟馬。

translations.literal: Mang resented that Xuan had sought to withdraw, and therefore did not grant him gold, a comfort carriage, or four horses.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang resented that Xuan had sought to withdraw, and therefore did not grant him gold, a comfort carriage, or four horses.

sentences.zh: 宣居國數年，薨。

translations.literal: Xuan dwelt in his state several years and died.
translations.idiomatic: Xuan dwelt in his state several years and died.

sentences.zh: 班固贊曰：薛廣德保縣車之榮，平當逡巡有恥，彭宣見險而止，異乎苟患失之者矣！

translations.literal: Ban Gu's encomium says: Xue Guangde preserved the honor of hanging up his carriage; Ping Dang hesitated with a sense of shame; Peng Xuan saw peril and stopped—how different from those who clutch at gain and fear loss!
translations.idiomatic: Ban Gu's encomium says: Xue Guangde preserved the honor of hanging up his carriage; Ping Dang hesitated with a sense of shame; Peng Xuan saw peril and stopped—how different from those who clutch at gain and fear loss!

sentences.zh: 戊午，右將軍王崇為大司空，光祿勳東海馬宮為右將軍，左曹、中郎將甄豐為光祿勳。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Right General Wang Chong was made Grand Minister of Works, Household Minister of the Imperial Clan Ma Gong of Donghai was made Right General, and Left Censor and Palace Gentleman Zhen Feng was made Household Minister of the Imperial Clan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Right General Wang Chong was made Grand Minister of Works, Household Minister of the Imperial Clan Ma Gong of Donghai was made Right General, and Left Censor and Palace Gentleman Zhen Feng was made Household Minister of the Imperial Clan.

sentences.zh: 九月，辛酉，中山王即皇帝位，大赦天下。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on xinyou, the King of Zhongshan assumed the imperial throne and proclaimed a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinyou, the King of Zhongshan assumed the imperial throne and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 平帝年九歲，太皇太后臨朝，大司馬莽秉政，百官總己以聽於莽。

translations.literal: Emperor Ping was nine years old; the grand empress dowager held court; Grand Marshal Mang wielded government; the hundred officials gathered their affairs to heed Mang.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Ping was nine years old; the grand empress dowager held court; Grand Marshal Wang Mang wielded government; the hundred officials gathered their affairs to heed Wang Mang.

sentences.zh: 莽權日盛，孔光憂懼，不知所出，上書乞骸骨；

translations.literal: Mang's power daily grew; Kong Guang was anxious and fearful and did not know what course to take; he submitted a memorial begging his old bones;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang's power daily grew; Kong Guang was anxious and fearful and did not know what course to take; he submitted a memorial begging to retire;

sentences.zh: 莽白太后，帝幼少，宜置師傅，徙光為帝太傅，位四輔，給事中，領宿衛、供養，行內署門戶，省服御食物。

translations.literal: Mang reported to the empress dowager that the emperor was young and it was fitting to set up tutors; Guang was moved to be the emperor's Grand Tutor, with rank among the Four Supports, Gentlemen Attendant Within the Yellow Gates, overseeing night guards and maintenance, conducting inner-palace gates and doors, and inspecting clothing and food for the imperial person.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang reported to the empress dowager that the emperor was young and it was fitting to set up tutors; Guang was moved to be the emperor's Grand Tutor, with rank among the Four Supports, Gentlemen Attendant Within the Yellow Gates, overseeing night guards and maintenance, conducting inner-palace gates and doors, and inspecting clothing and food for the imperial person.

sentences.zh: 以馬宮為大司徒，甄豐為右將軍。

translations.literal: Ma Gong was made Grand Minister of Education and Zhen Feng Right General.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Gong was made Grand Minister of Education and Zhen Feng Right General.

sentences.zh: 冬，十月，壬寅，葬孝哀皇帝於義陵。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on renyin, Emperor Xia'ai was buried at Yiling.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on renyin, Emperor Xia'ai was buried at Yiling.

sentences.zh: 孝平皇帝上

translations.literal: Emperor Ping, Part One
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Ping, Part One

sentences.zh: 春，正月，王莽風益州，令塞外蠻夷自稱越裳氏重譯獻白雉一、黑雉二。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month, Wang Mang influenced Yizhou to have the barbarians beyond the passes who called themselves the Yuechang clan present tribute through repeated translation—a white pheasant one, black pheasants two.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, the first month, Wang Mang influenced Yizhou to have the barbarians beyond the passes who called themselves the Yuechang clan present tribute through repeated translation—one white pheasant and two black pheasants.

sentences.zh: 莽白太后下詔，以白雉薦宗廟。

translations.literal: Mang reported to the empress dowager to issue an edict offering the white pheasant to the ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang reported to the empress dowager to issue an edict offering the white pheasant to the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 於是群臣盛陳莽功德，致周成白雉之瑞，周公及身在而托號於周，莽宜賜號曰安漢公，益戶疇爵邑。

translations.literal: Thereupon the ministers greatly set forth Mang's merit and virtue, saying he had brought the auspice of the white pheasant of King Cheng of Zhou; the Duke of Zhou while still alive entrusted the Zhou title to another—Mang ought to be granted the title Lord Who Pacifies Han, with increased households, fiefs, and noble lands.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the ministers greatly set forth Wang Mang's merit and virtue, saying he had brought the auspice of the white pheasant of King Cheng of Zhou; the Duke of Zhou while still alive entrusted the Zhou title to another—Wang Mang ought to be granted the title Lord Who Pacifies Han, with increased households, fiefs, and noble lands.

sentences.zh: 太后詔尚書具其事。

translations.literal: The empress dowager edicted the Masters of Writing to prepare the matter in detail.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager edicted the Masters of Writing to prepare the matter in detail.

sentences.zh: 莽上書言：「臣與孔光、王舜、甄豐、甄邯共定策；

translations.literal: Mang submitted a memorial, saying: "Your subject together with Kong Guang, Wang Shun, Zhen Feng, and Zhen Han jointly settled the policy;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang submitted a memorial, saying, "Your subject together with Kong Guang, Wang Shun, Zhen Feng, and Zhen Han jointly settled the policy;

sentences.zh: 今願獨條光等功賞，寢置臣莽，勿隨輩列。

translations.literal: "now I wish to set forth only Guang and the others' merits for reward, and set aside your subject Mang—do not place me in the same rank."
translations.idiomatic: "now I wish to set forth only Guang and the others' merits for reward, and set aside your subject Wang Mang—do not place me in the same rank."

sentences.zh: 」甄邯白太后下詔曰：「『無偏無黨，王道蕩蕩。

translations.literal: " Zhen Han reported to the empress dowager to issue an edict, saying: "'Without partiality, without faction—the kingly way is vast and broad.
translations.idiomatic: " Zhen Han reported to the empress dowager to issue an edict, saying, "'Without partiality, without faction—the kingly way is vast and broad.

sentences.zh: 』君有安宗廟之功，不可以骨肉故蔽隱不揚，君其勿辭！

translations.literal: ' You, sir, have the merit of securing the ancestral temples—you cannot because of kinship cover and hide it without proclaiming it; pray do not decline!"
translations.idiomatic: ' You, sir, have the merit of securing the ancestral temples—you cannot because of kinship cover and hide it without proclaiming it; pray do not decline!"

sentences.zh: 」莽復上書固讓數四，稱疾不起。

translations.literal: " Mang again submitted memorials firmly declining four times and claimed illness, refusing to rise.
translations.idiomatic: " Wang Mang again submitted memorials firmly declining four times and claimed illness, refusing to rise.

sentences.zh: 左右白太后，「宜勿奪莽意，但條孔光等，莽乃肯起。

translations.literal: Those at his side reported to the empress dowager: "It is fitting not to thwart Mang's intent but only to set forth Kong Guang and the others—then Mang will be willing to rise."
translations.idiomatic: Those at his side reported to the empress dowager, "It is fitting not to thwart Wang Mang's intent but only to set forth Kong Guang and the others—then Wang Mang will be willing to rise."

sentences.zh: 」二月，丙辰，太后下詔；

translations.literal: " In the second month, on bingchen, the empress dowager issued an edict;
translations.idiomatic: " In the second month, on bingchen, the empress dowager issued an edict;

sentences.zh: 「以太傅、博山侯光為太師，車騎將軍、安陽侯舜為太保，皆益封萬戶。

translations.literal: "Grand Tutor and Marquis of Boshan Guang is made Grand Preceptor; Commandant of Cavalry and Marquis of Anyang Shun is made Grand Guardian—both with increased enfeoffment of ten thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: "Grand Tutor and Marquis of Boshan Guang is made Grand Preceptor; Commandant of Cavalry and Marquis of Anyang Shun is made Grand Guardian—both with increased enfeoffment of ten thousand households.

sentences.zh: 左將軍、光祿勳豐為少傅，封廣陽侯。

translations.literal: Left General and Household Minister of the Imperial Clan Feng is made Junior Tutor and enfeoffed as Marquis of Guangyang.
translations.idiomatic: Left General and Household Minister of the Imperial Clan Feng is made Junior Tutor and enfeoffed as Marquis of Guangyang.

sentences.zh: 皆授四輔之職。

translations.literal: All are granted the duties of the Four Supports.
translations.idiomatic: All are granted the duties of the Four Supports.

sentences.zh: 侍中、奉車都尉邯封承陽侯。

translations.literal: Attendant-in-Ordinary and Commandant Who Conducts the Carriages Han is enfeoffed as Marquis of Chengyang.
translations.idiomatic: Attendant-in-Ordinary and Commandant Who Conducts the Carriages Han is enfeoffed as Marquis of Chengyang.

sentences.zh: 」四人既受賞，莽尚未起。

translations.literal: " The four men having received reward, Mang had still not risen.
translations.idiomatic: " The four men having received reward, Wang Mang had still not risen.

sentences.zh: 群臣復上言：「莽雖克讓，朝所宜章，以時加賞，明重元功，無使百僚元元失望！

translations.literal: The ministers again submitted, saying: "Though Mang can decline, the court ought to make manifest it; reward him in season, clarify and honor the primary merit—do not let the hundred officials and the primordial masses be disappointed!"
translations.idiomatic: The ministers again submitted, saying, "Though Wang Mang can decline, the court ought to make manifest it; reward him in season, clarify and honor the primary merit—do not let the hundred officials and the common people be disappointed!"

sentences.zh: 」太后乃下詔：「以大司馬、新都侯莽為太傅，干四輔之事，號曰安漢公，益封二萬八千戶。

translations.literal: " The empress dowager thereupon issued an edict: "Grand Marshal and Marquis of Xindu Mang is made Grand Tutor, overseeing the affairs of the Four Supports, with the title Lord Who Pacifies Han, and increased enfeoffment of twenty-eight thousand households."
translations.idiomatic: " The empress dowager thereupon issued an edict: "Grand Marshal and Marquis of Xindu Wang Mang is made Grand Tutor, overseeing the affairs of the Four Supports, with the title Lord Who Pacifies Han, and increased enfeoffment of twenty-eight thousand households."

sentences.zh: 」於是莽為惶恐，不得已而起，受太傅、安漢公號，讓還益封事，云：「願須百姓家給，然後加賞。

translations.literal: " Thereupon Mang acted in alarm and fear, rose because he had no choice, received the Grand Tutor and Lord Who Pacifies Han titles, and declined returning the matter of increased enfeoffment, saying: "I wish to wait until the hundred surnames' households are provided for, and only then add reward."
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon Wang Mang acted in alarm and fear, rose because he had no choice, received the Grand Tutor and Lord Who Pacifies Han titles, and declined returning the matter of increased enfeoffment, saying, "I wish to wait until the people's households are provided for, and only then add reward."

sentences.zh: 」群臣復爭，太后詔曰：「公自期百姓家給，是以聽之，其令公奉賜皆倍故。

translations.literal: " The ministers again contended; the empress dowager edicted: "The lord himself set the term that the hundred surnames' households be provided for—therefore I heed it; let all the lord's stipends and gifts be doubled from before.
translations.idiomatic: " The ministers again contended; the empress dowager edicted, "The lord himself set the term that the people's households be provided for—therefore I heed it; let all the lord's stipends and gifts be doubled from before.

sentences.zh: 百姓家給人足，大司徒、大司空以聞。

translations.literal: When the hundred surnames' households are provided for and men are full, the Grand Minister of Education and Grand Minister of Works shall report it."
translations.idiomatic: When the people's households are provided for and men are full, the Grand Minister of Education and Grand Minister of Works shall report it."

sentences.zh: 」莽復讓不受，而建言褒賞宗室群臣。

translations.literal: " Mang again declined and would not accept, but memorialized to praise and reward the imperial clan and the ministers.
translations.idiomatic: " Wang Mang again declined and would not accept, but memorialized to praise and reward the imperial clan and the ministers.

sentences.zh: 立故東平王雲太子開明為王；

translations.literal: He established the former King of Dongping Yun's heir Kaiming as king;
translations.idiomatic: He established the former King of Dongping Yun's heir Kaiming as king;

sentences.zh: 又以故東平思王孫成都為中山王，奉孝王后；

translations.literal: and again made the former King of Dongping Siyi's grandson Chengdu King of Zhongshan to serve Empress Xiaohou;
translations.idiomatic: and again made the former King of Dongping Siyi's grandson Chengdu King of Zhongshan to serve Empress Xiaohou;

sentences.zh: 封宣帝耳孫信等三十六人皆為列侯；

translations.literal: he enfeoffed Emperor Xuan's great-great-grandsons Xin and thirty-six others all as ranked marquises;
translations.idiomatic: he enfeoffed Emperor Xuan's great-great-grandsons Xin and thirty-six others all as ranked marquises;

sentences.zh: 太僕王惲等二十五人皆賜爵關內侯。

translations.literal: Grand Coachman Wang Yun and twenty-five others were all granted rank as marquises within the passes.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coachman Wang Yun and twenty-five others were all granted rank as marquises within the passes.

sentences.zh: 又令諸侯王公、列侯、關內侯無子而有孫若同產子者，皆得以為嗣；

translations.literal: He also ordered that feudal lords, kings and dukes, ranked marquises, and marquises within the passes who had no sons but had grandsons or sons by the same mother might all take them as heirs;
translations.idiomatic: He also ordered that feudal lords, kings and dukes, ranked marquises, and marquises within the passes who had no sons but had grandsons or sons of the same mother might all take them as heirs;

sentences.zh: 宗室屬未盡而以罪絕者，復其屬；

translations.literal: For imperial clansmen whose lines were not yet exhausted but had been cut off by crime, their lines were restored;
translations.idiomatic: For imperial clansmen whose lines were not yet exhausted but had been cut off for crime, their lines were restored;

sentences.zh: 天下令比二千石以上年老致仕者，參分故祿，以一與之，終其身。

translations.literal: Throughout the realm, those at the rank of 2,000 bushels and above who retired on account of old age were given one-third of their former salary for life.
translations.idiomatic: Throughout the realm, officials at the rank of 2,000 bushels and above who retired on account of old age were given one-third of their former salary for life.

sentences.zh: 下及庶民鰥寡，恩澤之政，無所不施。

translations.literal: Down to commoners, widowers and widows—the policies of grace and favor were applied everywhere.
translations.idiomatic: Down to commoners, widowers and widows—policies of grace and favor were applied everywhere.

sentences.zh: 莽既媚說吏民，又欲專斷，知太后老，厭政，乃風公卿奏言：「往者吏以功次遷至二千石，及州部所舉茂材異等吏，率多不稱，宜皆見安漢公。

translations.literal: Wang Mang having already won over officials and the people, also wished to monopolize decisions; knowing the Empress Dowager was old and weary of government, he prompted the excellencies and ministers to memorialize: "In the past officials promoted by merit sequence to 2,000 bushels, and the outstanding-talent and exceptional-grade officers recommended by provinces and departments, mostly did not measure up—all ought to be presented to the Duke of Anhan."
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang, having already won over officials and the people, also wished to monopolize decisions; knowing the Empress Dowager was old and weary of government, he prompted the excellencies and ministers to memorialize, "In the past officials promoted by merit to 2,000 bushels, and the outstanding-talent and exceptional-grade officers recommended by provinces and departments, mostly did not measure up—all ought to be presented to the Duke of Anhan."

sentences.zh: 又，太后春秋高，不宜親省小事。

translations.literal: Moreover, the Empress Dowager's years are advanced and she ought not personally examine minor matters.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, the Empress Dowager's years are advanced and she ought not personally examine minor matters.

sentences.zh: 」令太后下詔曰：「自今以來，唯封爵乃以聞，他事安漢公、四輔平決。

translations.literal: " He had the Empress Dowager issue an edict: "From now on, only enfeoffments and titles are to be reported to Us; other matters are peacefully decided by the Duke of Anhan and the Four Assistants."
translations.idiomatic: " He had the Empress Dowager issue an edict: "From now on, only enfeoffments and titles are to be reported to Us; other matters are peacefully decided by the Duke of Anhan and the Four Assistants."

sentences.zh: 州牧、二千石及茂材吏初除奏事者，輒引入，至近署對安漢公，考故官，問新職，以知其稱否。

translations.literal: Provincial governors, 2,000-bushel officials, and outstanding-talent officers newly appointed who came to report were immediately brought in to the nearby office to face the Duke of Anhan, who examined their former offices and questioned their new duties to know whether they measured up.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial governors, 2,000-bushel officials, and outstanding-talent officers newly appointed who came to report were immediately brought in to the nearby office to face the Duke of Anhan, who examined their former offices and questioned their new duties to learn whether they measured up.

sentences.zh: 」於是莽人人延問，密緻恩意，厚加贈送，其不合指，顯奏免之，權與人主侔矣。

translations.literal: " Thereupon Mang questioned each person at length, secretly applying favor and intent, richly bestowing gifts; those who did not fit his purpose he openly memorialized to dismiss—his power was on a par with the ruler's.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon Mang questioned each person at length, secretly showing favor, and richly bestowed gifts; those who did not suit his purpose he openly memorialized to dismiss—his power was on a par with the ruler's.

sentences.zh: 置羲和官，秩二千石。

translations.literal: He established the office of Minister of the Sun (Xihe), rank 2,000 bushels.
translations.idiomatic: He established the office of Minister of the Sun (Xihe), rank 2,000 bushels.

sentences.zh: 夏，五月，丁巳朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month, on dingsi the new moon, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fifth month, on dingsi the new moon, there was an eclipse of the sun.

sentences.zh: 大赦天下。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed for the realm.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed for the realm.

sentences.zh: 公卿以下舉敦厚能直言者各一人。

translations.literal: From excellencies and ministers downward, each recommended one person who was sincere and substantial and able to speak straight.
translations.idiomatic: From excellencies and ministers downward, each recommended one person who was sincere and substantial and able to speak frankly.

sentences.zh: 王莽恐帝外家衛氏奪其權，白太后：「前哀帝立，背恩義，自貴外家丁、傅，橈亂國家，幾危社稷。

translations.literal: Wang Mang feared the emperor's maternal clan the Weis would seize his power; he told the Empress Dowager: "When the former Emperor Ai was enthroned, he turned his back on grace and righteousness, exalted his maternal clans the Ding and Fu, bent and troubled the state, and nearly endangered the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang feared the emperor's maternal clan the Weis would seize his power; he told the Empress Dowager, "When the former Emperor Ai was enthroned, he turned his back on grace and righteousness, exalted his maternal clans the Ding and Fu, bent and troubled the state, and nearly endangered the altars of state.

sentences.zh: 今帝以幼年復奉大宗為成帝后，宜明一統之義，以戒前事，為後代法。

translations.literal: Now the emperor in his tender years again continues the great lineage as successor to Emperor Cheng; the meaning of unified succession ought to be made clear, to warn against the former affair and set a law for later generations."
translations.idiomatic: Now the emperor in his tender years again continues the great lineage as successor to Emperor Cheng; the meaning of unified succession ought to be made clear, to warn against the former affair and set a law for later generations."

sentences.zh: 」六月，遣甄豐奉璽綬，即拜帝母衛姬為中山孝王后。

translations.literal: " Sixth month, he dispatched Zhen Feng bearing the seal and sash to invest the emperor's mother Lady Wei as Empress Dowager of Xiaowang of Zhongshan.
translations.idiomatic: " In the sixth month, he dispatched Zhen Feng bearing the seal and sash to invest the emperor's mother Lady Wei as Empress Dowager of Xiaowang of Zhongshan.

sentences.zh: 賜帝舅衛寶、寶弟玄爵關內侯。

translations.literal: He granted the emperor's uncle Wei Bao and Bao's younger brother Xuan noble rank within the passes.
translations.idiomatic: He granted the emperor's uncle Wei Bao and Bao's younger brother Xuan noble rank within the passes.

sentences.zh: 賜帝女弟三人號曰君，皆留中山，不得至京師。

translations.literal: He granted the emperor's three younger sisters the title of lordess; all were kept at Zhongshan and could not come to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: He granted the emperor's three younger sisters the title of lordess; all were kept at Zhongshan and could not come to the capital.

sentences.zh: 扶風功曹申屠剛以直言對策曰：「臣聞成王幼少，周公攝政，聽言下賢，均權布寵，動順天地，舉措不失；

translations.literal: Fufeng Merit Officer Shentu Gang, in a straight-speaking policy response, said: "Your servant has heard that when King Cheng was young, the Duke of Zhou acted as regent—heeding words, lowering himself to the worthy, evening out power and spreading favor, his movements accorded with Heaven and Earth and his actions did not miss;
translations.idiomatic: Fufeng Merit Officer Shentu Gang, in a frank policy response, said, "Your servant has heard that when King Cheng was young, the Duke of Zhou acted as regent—heeding counsel, lowering himself to the worthy, evening out power and spreading favor, his movements accorded with Heaven and Earth and his conduct did not err;

sentences.zh: 然近則召公不說，遠則四國流言。

translations.literal: yet near at hand the Duke of Shao was displeased, and far off the four states spread slander."
translations.idiomatic: yet near at hand the Duke of Shao was displeased, and far off the four states spread slander."

sentences.zh: 今聖主始免襁褓，即位以來，至親分離，外戚杜隔，恩不得通。

translations.literal: Now the sage sovereign has only just left swaddling clothes; since his accession, his closest kin have been separated, maternal kin walled off and isolated, and grace cannot flow through.
translations.idiomatic: Now the sage sovereign has only just left swaddling clothes; since his accession, his closest kin have been separated, maternal kin walled off and isolated, and familial grace cannot flow through.

sentences.zh: 且漢家之制，雖任英賢，猶援姻戚，親疏相錯，杜塞間隙，誠所以安宗廟，重社稷也。

translations.literal: Moreover Han's institutions, though employing outstanding worthies, still rely on affinal kin—near and distant interwoven, blocking gaps—truly so as to secure the ancestral temple and weigh heavy the altars of state.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Han's institutions, though employing outstanding worthies, still rely on affinal kin—near and distant interwoven, blocking gaps—truly so as to secure the ancestral temple and safeguard the altars of state.

sentences.zh: 宜亟遣使者征中山太后，置之別宮，令時朝見，又召馮、衛二族，裁與冗職，使得執戟親奉宿衛，以抑患禍之端。

translations.literal: [Your Majesty] ought urgently to dispatch envoys to summon the Empress Dowager of Zhongshan, place her in a separate palace with regular audiences; also summon the Feng and Wei clans, give them only supernumerary posts, enable them to bear halberds and personally serve in night guard, to check the beginnings of disaster and calamity."
translations.idiomatic: [Your Majesty] ought urgently to dispatch envoys to summon the Empress Dowager of Zhongshan, place her in a separate palace with regular audiences; also summon the Feng and Wei clans, give them only supernumerary posts, enable them to bear halberds and personally serve in night guard, to check the beginnings of disaster and calamity."

sentences.zh: 上安社稷，下全保傅。

translations.literal: Above to secure the altars of state, below to complete the protection of the tutors."
translations.idiomatic: Above to secure the altars of state, below to complete the protection of the tutors."

sentences.zh: 」莽令太后下詔曰：「剛所言僻經妄說，違背大義。

translations.literal: " Wang Mang had the Empress Dowager issue an edict: "What Gang said is heterodox classicism and reckless talk, violating the great meaning."
translations.idiomatic: " Wang Mang had the Empress Dowager issue an edict: "What Gang said is heterodox classicism and reckless talk, violating the great meaning."

sentences.zh: 」罷歸田裡。

translations.literal: " He was dismissed and returned to his fields.
translations.idiomatic: " He was dismissed and returned to his fields.

sentences.zh: 丙午，封魯頃公之八世孫公子寬為褒魯侯，奉周公祀；

translations.literal: On bingwu, he enfeoffed the eighth-generation descendant of Duke Qing of Lu, the lord's son Kuan, as Marquis of Baolu, to maintain sacrifices to the Duke of Zhou;
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, he enfeoffed the eighth-generation descendant of Duke Qing of Lu, the lord's son Kuan, as Marquis of Baolu, to maintain sacrifices to the Duke of Zhou;

sentences.zh: 封褒成君孔霸曾孫均為褒成侯，奉孔子祀。

translations.literal: he enfeoffed the great-grandson Jun of Marquis of Baocheng Kong Ba as Marquis of Baocheng, to maintain sacrifices to Confucius.
translations.idiomatic: he enfeoffed the great-grandson Jun of Marquis of Baocheng Kong Ba as Marquis of Baocheng, to maintain sacrifices to Confucius.

sentences.zh: 詔：「天下女徒已論，歸家，出雇山錢，月三百。

translations.literal: Edict: "Female convicts throughout the realm who have been sentenced are sent home and given mountain-hire money of three hundred per month."
translations.idiomatic: Edict: "Female convicts throughout the realm who have been sentenced are sent home and given mountain-hire money of three hundred per month."

sentences.zh: 復貞婦，鄉一人。

translations.literal: Chaste wives were restored [from tax], one per district.
translations.idiomatic: Taxes were restored for chaste wives, one per district.

sentences.zh: 大司農部丞十三人，人部一州，勸農桑。

translations.literal: Thirteen clerks of the Grand Minister of Agriculture, each assigned to one province, to encourage agriculture and sericulture.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteen clerks of the Grand Minister of Agriculture, each assigned to one province, to encourage agriculture and sericulture.

sentences.zh: 秋，九月，赦天下徒。

translations.literal: Autumn, ninth month, convicts throughout the realm were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the ninth month, convicts throughout the realm were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 春，黃支國獻犀牛。

translations.literal: Spring, the state of Huangzhi presented a rhinoceros.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, the state of Huangzhi presented a rhinoceros.

sentences.zh: 黃支在南海中，去京師三萬里。

translations.literal: Huangzhi was in the southern sea, thirty thousand li from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Huangzhi lay in the southern sea, thirty thousand li from the capital.

sentences.zh: 王莽欲耀威德，故厚遺其王，令遣使貢獻。

translations.literal: Wang Mang wished to display prestige and virtue; therefore he richly sent gifts to its king and had him dispatch envoys to present tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang wished to display prestige and virtue; therefore he richly sent gifts to its king and had him dispatch envoys to present tribute.

sentences.zh: 越巂郡上黃龍游江中。

translations.literal: Yuexi Commandery reported a yellow dragon swimming in the river.
translations.idiomatic: Yuexi Commandery reported a yellow dragon swimming in the river.

sentences.zh: 太師光、大司徒宮等咸稱「莽功德比周公，宜告祠宗廟。

translations.literal: Grand Tutor Guang, Grand Minister of the Masses Gong, and others all said, "Mang's merit and virtue equal the Duke of Zhou; he ought to announce sacrifice at the ancestral temple."
translations.idiomatic: Grand Tutor Guang, Grand Minister of the Masses Gong, and others all said, "Mang's merit and virtue equal the Duke of Zhou; he ought to announce sacrifice at the ancestral temple."

sentences.zh: 」大司農孫寶曰：「周公上聖，召公大賢，尚猶有不相說，著於經典，兩不相損。

translations.literal: " Grand Minister of Agriculture Sun Bao said: "The Duke of Zhou was a supreme sage, the Duke of Shao a great worthy—yet they still had mutual displeasure, recorded in the classics, and neither was harmed.
translations.idiomatic: " Grand Minister of Agriculture Sun Bao said, "The Duke of Zhou was a supreme sage and the Duke of Shao a great worthy—yet they still had mutual displeasure, recorded in the classics, and neither was harmed.

sentences.zh: 今風雨未時，百姓不足，每有一事，群臣同聲，得無非其美者？

translations.literal: Now wind and rain are not timely, the hundred surnames are insufficient—whenever there is one affair the ministers speak in one voice; might there not be someone who is not praising his true [merits]?"
translations.idiomatic: Now wind and rain are not timely and the people are in want—whenever there is one affair the ministers speak in one voice; might there not be someone who is not praising his true merits?"

sentences.zh: 」時大臣皆失色。

translations.literal: " At the time the great ministers all changed color.
translations.idiomatic: " At the time the great ministers all changed color.

sentences.zh: 甄邯即時承製罷議者。

translations.literal: Zhen Han immediately received the imperial command and dismissed those in deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen Han immediately received the imperial command and dismissed those in deliberation.

sentences.zh: 會寶遣吏迎母，母道病，留弟家，獨遣妻子。

translations.literal: It happened that Bao sent an official to welcome his mother; his mother fell ill on the road and stayed at his younger brother's house—he sent only his wife and children.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that Bao sent an official to welcome his mother; his mother fell ill on the road and stayed at his younger brother's house—he sent only his wife and children.

sentences.zh: 司直陳崇劾奏寶，事下三公即訊。

translations.literal: Director of Justice Chen Chong impeached Bao; the matter was sent down to the Three Excellencies for immediate inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: Director of Justice Chen Chong impeached Bao; the matter was sent down to the Three Excellencies for immediate inquiry.

sentences.zh: 寶對曰：「年七十，悖眊，恩衰共養，營妻子，如章。

translations.literal: Bao replied: "Age seventy, confused and dim—family grace has faded in joint nurture; I looked after wife and children, as in the impeachment."
translations.idiomatic: Bao replied, "Age seventy, confused and dim—family grace has faded in joint nurture; I looked after wife and children, as in the impeachment."

sentences.zh: 」寶坐免，終於家。

translations.literal: Bao was convicted and dismissed; he ended his days at home.
translations.idiomatic: Bao was convicted and dismissed; he ended his days at home.

sentences.zh: 帝更名衎。

translations.literal: The emperor's name was changed to Kan.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's name was changed to Kan.

sentences.zh: 三月，癸酉，大司空王崇謝病免，以避王莽。

translations.literal: Third month, on guiyou, Grand Minister of Works Wang Chong resigned citing illness, to avoid Wang Mang.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guiyou, Grand Minister of Works Wang Chong resigned citing illness, to avoid Wang Mang.

sentences.zh: 夏，四月，丁酉，左將軍甄豐為大司空，右將軍孫建為左將軍，光祿勳甄邯為右將軍。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on dingyou, Left General Zhen Feng became Grand Minister of Works, Right General Sun Jian became Left General, Household Master of the Heir Zhen Han became Right General.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on dingyou, Left General Zhen Feng became Grand Minister of Works, Right General Sun Jian became Left General, and Household Master of the Heir Zhen Han became Right General.

sentences.zh: 立代孝王玄孫之子如意為廣宗王，江都易王孫盱台侯宮為廣川王，廣川惠王曾孫倫為廣德王。

translations.literal: He established Ruoyi, son of the great-grandson of King Xiao of Dai, as King of Guangzong; the grandson of King Yi of Jiangdu, Marquis of Xutai Gong, as King of Guangchuan; and Lun, great-grandson of King Hui of Guangchuan, as King of Guangde.
translations.idiomatic: He established Ruoyi, son of the great-grandson of King Xiao of Dai, as King of Guangzong; Gong, grandson of King Yi of Jiangdu and Marquis of Xutai, as King of Guangchuan; and Lun, great-grandson of King Hui of Guangchuan, as King of Guangde.

sentences.zh: 紹封漢興以來大功臣之後周共等皆為列侯及關內侯，凡百一十七人。

translations.literal: He continued enfeoffments for descendants of great merit subjects since Han's rise—Zhou Gong and others—all as ranked marquises and marquises within the passes, one hundred seventeen in all.
translations.idiomatic: He continued enfeoffments for descendants of great merit subjects since Han's rise—Zhou Gong and others—all as ranked marquises and marquises within the passes, one hundred seventeen in all.

sentences.zh: 郡國大旱，蝗，青州尤甚，民流亡。

translations.literal: Commanderies and states suffered great drought and locusts; Qing province was especially severe; the people wandered away in exile.
translations.idiomatic: Commanderies and states suffered great drought and locusts; Qing province was especially severe, and the people wandered away in exile.

sentences.zh: 王莽白太后，宜衣繒練，頗損膳，以示天下。

translations.literal: Wang Mang told the Empress Dowager she ought to wear fine silk and plain cloth and somewhat reduce her meals to show the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang told the Empress Dowager she ought to wear plain silk and reduce her meals somewhat, to show the realm.

sentences.zh: 莽因上書願出錢百萬，獻田三十頃，付大司農助給貧民。

translations.literal: Mang thereupon submitted a memorial wishing to contribute one million in cash and offer thirty qing of fields to the Grand Minister of Agriculture to help supply the poor.
translations.idiomatic: Mang thereupon submitted a memorial wishing to contribute one million in cash and offer thirty qing of fields to the Grand Minister of Agriculture to help supply the poor.

sentences.zh: 於是公卿皆慕效焉，凡獻田宅者二百三十人，以口賦貧民。

translations.literal: Thereupon the excellencies and ministers all imitated in admiration; in all two hundred thirty persons offered fields and residences, distributing to the poor by household count.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the excellencies and ministers all imitated him; in all two hundred thirty persons offered fields and residences, distributing to the poor by household count.

sentences.zh: 又起五里於長安城中，宅二百區，以居貧民。

translations.literal: He also built wards within Chang'an city—two hundred compounds—to house the poor.
translations.idiomatic: He also built wards within Chang'an city—two hundred compounds—to house the poor.

sentences.zh: 莽帥群臣奏太后，言：「幸賴陛下德澤，間者風雨時，甘露降，神芝生，蓂莢、朱草、嘉禾，休征同時並至。

translations.literal: Mang led the assembled ministers to memorialize the Empress Dowager, saying: "Fortunately relying on Your Majesty's virtuous grace, recently wind and rain have been timely, sweet dew has fallen, divine fungi have grown, mingqia pods, vermilion grass, and good grain—all auspicious omens have arrived together at once.
translations.idiomatic: Mang led the assembled ministers to memorialize the Empress Dowager, saying, "Fortunately relying on Your Majesty's virtuous grace, recently wind and rain have been timely, sweet dew has fallen, divine fungi have grown, mingqia pods, vermilion grass, and good grain—all auspicious omens have arrived together at once.

sentences.zh: 願陛下遵帝王之常服，復太官之法膳，使臣子各得盡歡心，備共養！

translations.literal: We wish Your Majesty to follow emperors' and kings' regular dress, restore the Grand Provisioner's statutory meals, and enable your subjects each to fulfill shared nurture!"
translations.idiomatic: We wish Your Majesty to follow emperors' and kings' regular dress, restore the Grand Provisioner's statutory meals, and enable your subjects each to fulfill shared nurture!"

sentences.zh: 」莽又令太后下詔，不許。

translations.literal: " Mang also had the Empress Dowager issue an edict—not permitting it.
translations.idiomatic: " Mang also had the Empress Dowager issue an edict—not permitting it.

sentences.zh: 每有水旱，莽輒素食，左右以白太后，太后遣使者詔莽曰：「聞公菜食，憂民深矣。

translations.literal: Whenever there was flood or drought, Mang would eat only vegetables; those about him reported to the Empress Dowager; the Empress Dowager sent an envoy to edict Mang: "We have heard the Duke eats vegetables—his concern for the people is deep.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever there was flood or drought, Mang would eat only vegetables; those about him reported to the Empress Dowager; the Empress Dowager sent an envoy to edict Mang, "We have heard the Duke eats vegetables—his concern for the people is deep.

sentences.zh: 今秋幸孰，公以時食肉，愛身為國！

translations.literal: This autumn the grain is fortunately ripe; the Duke ought to eat meat in season—cherish your body for the state's sake!"
translations.idiomatic: This autumn the grain is fortunately ripe; the Duke ought to eat meat in season—cherish your body for the state's sake!"

sentences.zh: 六月，隕石於巨鹿二。

translations.literal: Sixth month, meteorites fell at the two Julu districts.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, meteorites fell at the two Julu districts.

sentences.zh: 光祿大夫楚國龔勝、太中大夫琅邪邴漢以王莽專政，皆乞骸骨。

translations.literal: Household Grandee Gong Sheng of Chu and Palace Counselor Bing Han of Langye, because Wang Mang monopolized government, both begged to surrender their bones [retire].
translations.idiomatic: Household Grandee Gong Sheng of Chu and Palace Counselor Bing Han of Langye, because Wang Mang monopolized government, both begged to retire.

sentences.zh: 莽令太后策詔之曰：「朕愍以官職之事煩大夫，大夫其修身守道，以終高年。

translations.literal: Mang had the Empress Dowager issue written edicts to them: "We pity that official duties have troubled the great counselors; let the great counselors cultivate body and guard the Way to complete their high years."
translations.idiomatic: Mang had the Empress Dowager issue written edicts to them: "We pity that official duties have troubled the great counselors; let the great counselors cultivate body and guard the Way to complete their high years."

sentences.zh: 」皆加優禮而遣之。

translations.literal: Both were given added honorable rites and sent away.
translations.idiomatic: Both were given added honorable rites and sent away.

sentences.zh: 梅福知王莽必篡漢祚，一朝棄妻子去，不知所之。

translations.literal: Mei Fu knew Wang Mang would surely usurp Han's mandate; one morning he abandoned wife and children and left—none knew whither.
translations.idiomatic: Mei Fu knew Wang Mang would surely usurp Han's mandate; one morning he abandoned wife and children and left—none knew whither.

sentences.zh: 其後，人有見福於會稽者，變姓名為吳市門卒雲。

translations.literal: Afterward someone saw Fu at Kuaiji; he had changed his name and become a gate guard at Wu market—or so it is said.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward someone saw Fu at Kuaiji; he had changed his name and become a gate guard at Wu market—or so it is said.

sentences.zh: 秋，九月，戊申晦，日有食之，赦天下徒。

translations.literal: Autumn, ninth month, on the last day wushen, there was an eclipse of the sun; convicts throughout the realm were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the ninth month, on the last day wushen, there was an eclipse of the sun; convicts throughout the realm were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 遣執金吾候陳茂諭說江湖賊成重等二百餘人皆自出，送家在所收事。

translations.literal: He dispatched Commandant of the Convoy of Metals Chen Mao to persuade bandits on rivers and lakes—Cheng Zhong and more than two hundred others—all came forth of themselves; they were sent to their home districts to receive judgment.
translations.idiomatic: He dispatched Commandant of the Convoy of Metals Chen Mao to persuade bandits on rivers and lakes—Cheng Zhong and more than two hundred others—all came forth of themselves; they were sent to their home districts to receive judgment.

sentences.zh: 重徙雲陽，賜公田宅。

translations.literal: Zhong was moved to Yunyang and granted public fields and a residence.
translations.idiomatic: Zhong was moved to Yunyang and granted public fields and a residence.

sentences.zh: 王莽欲悅太后以威德至盛，異於前，乃風單于令遣王昭君女須卜居次雲入侍太后，所以賞賜之甚厚。

translations.literal: Wang Mang wished to please the Empress Dowager with prestige and virtue surpassing the former; he prompted the Chanyu to send Wang Zhaojun's daughter Xubu Juci Yun to attend the Empress Dowager—the rewards and gifts for this were very rich.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang wished to please the Empress Dowager with prestige and virtue surpassing the former; he prompted the Chanyu to send Wang Zhaojun's daughter Xubu Juci Yun to attend the Empress Dowager—the rewards and gifts for this were very rich.

sentences.zh: 車師後王國有新道通玉門關，往來差近，戊己校尉徐普欲開之。

translations.literal: The kingdom of Rear Cheshi had a new road connecting to Yumen Pass—travel was somewhat nearer; the Wuji garrison commandant Xu Pu wished to open it.
translations.idiomatic: The kingdom of Rear Cheshi had a new road connecting to Yumen Pass—travel was somewhat nearer; the Wuji garrison commandant Xu Pu wished to open it.

sentences.zh: 車師後王姑句以當道供給使者，心不便也。

translations.literal: The king of Rear Cheshi, Jugu, because the road lay in his territory for supplying envoys, was ill-disposed in his heart.
translations.idiomatic: The king of Rear Cheshi, Jugu, because the road lay in his territory for supplying envoys, was ill-disposed in his heart.

sentences.zh: 普欲分明其界，然後奏之，召姑句使證之；

translations.literal: Pu wished to clarify the boundaries first, then memorialize; he summoned Jugu to testify;
translations.idiomatic: Pu wished to clarify the boundaries first, then memorialize; he summoned Jugu to testify;

sentences.zh: 不肯，系之。

translations.literal: Jugu refused and was imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: Jugu refused and was imprisoned.

sentences.zh: 其妻股紫陬謂姑句曰：「前車師前王為都護司馬所殺，今久系必死，不如降匈奴！

translations.literal: His wife Guzi said to Jugu: "Formerly the king of Front Cheshi was killed by the protector-general's major; now if long imprisoned you will surely die—better to submit to the Xiongnu!"
translations.idiomatic: His wife Guzi said to Jugu, "Formerly the king of Front Cheshi was killed by the protector-general's major; now if you are long imprisoned you will surely die—better to submit to the Xiongnu!"

sentences.zh: 」即馳突出高昌壁，入匈奴。

translations.literal: " Immediately he galloped out through Gaochang's wall and entered the Xiongnu.
translations.idiomatic: " Immediately he galloped out through Gaochang's wall and entered the Xiongnu.

sentences.zh: 又去胡來王唐兜與赤水羌數相寇，不勝，告急都護，都護但欽不以時救助。

translations.literal: Also the king of Hulai, Tang Dou, and the Chishui Qiang repeatedly raided each other; he could not prevail and reported emergency to the protector-general; Protector-General Dan Qin did not rescue in time.
translations.idiomatic: Also the king of Hulai, Tang Dou, and the Chishui Qiang repeatedly raided each other; he could not prevail and reported emergency to the protector-general; Protector-General Dan Qin did not rescue in time.

sentences.zh: 唐兜困急，怨欽，東守玉門關；

translations.literal: Tang Dou, pressed hard, resented Qin and went east to hold Yumen Pass;
translations.idiomatic: Tang Dou, pressed hard, resented Qin and went east to hold Yumen Pass;

sentences.zh: 玉門關不內，即將妻子、人民千餘人亡降匈奴。

translations.literal: Yumen Pass would not admit him; he immediately led his wife, children, and more than a thousand people to flee and submit to the Xiongnu.
translations.idiomatic: Yumen Pass would not admit him; he immediately led his wife, children, and more than a thousand people to flee and submit to the Xiongnu.

sentences.zh: 單于受，置左谷蠡地，遣使上書言狀，曰：「臣謹已受。

translations.literal: The Chanyu received them, settled them in Left Guli's territory, and sent an envoy with a memorial stating the facts: "Your subject has respectfully received them."
translations.idiomatic: The Chanyu received them, settled them in Left Guli's territory, and sent an envoy with a memorial stating the facts: "Your subject has respectfully received them."

sentences.zh: 」詔遣中郎將韓隆等使匈奴，責讓單于；

translations.literal: " An edict dispatched Gentleman of the Palace Han Long and others as envoys to the Xiongnu to reproach the Chanyu;
translations.idiomatic: " An edict dispatched Gentleman of the Palace Han Long and others as envoys to the Xiongnu to reproach the Chanyu;

sentences.zh: 單于叩頭謝罪，執二虜還付使者。

translations.literal: the Chanyu knocked his head and begged pardon, seized the two fugitives and returned them to the envoys.
translations.idiomatic: the Chanyu knocked his head and begged pardon, seized the two fugitives and returned them to the envoys.

sentences.zh: 詔使中郎將王萌待於西域惡都奴界上。

translations.literal: An edict had Palace Gentleman Wang Meng wait at the border of Wudunu in the Western Regions.
translations.idiomatic: An edict had Palace Gentleman Wang Meng wait at the border of Wudunu in the Western Regions.

sentences.zh: 單于遣使送，因請其罪；

translations.literal: The Chanyu sent envoys to deliver them and thereby asked their offense;
translations.idiomatic: The Chanyu sent envoys to deliver them and thereby asked their offense;

sentences.zh: 使者以聞。

translations.literal: the envoys reported it.
translations.idiomatic: the envoys reported it.

sentences.zh: 莽不聽，詔會西域諸國王，陳軍斬姑句、唐兜以示之。

translations.literal: Mang would not hear it; an edict assembled the kings of the Western Region states, displayed the army, and beheaded Jugu and Tang Dou to show them.
translations.idiomatic: Mang would not hear it; an edict assembled the kings of the Western Region states, displayed the army, and beheaded Jugu and Tang Dou to show them.

sentences.zh: 乃造設四條，中國人亡入匈奴者，烏孫亡降匈奴者，西域諸國佩中國印綬降匈奴者，烏桓降匈奴者，皆不得受。

translations.literal: He then fashioned four articles: Han subjects who fled into the Xiongnu, Wusun who surrendered to the Xiongnu, Western Region states wearing Han seals and cords who surrendered to the Xiongnu, and Wuhuan who surrendered to the Xiongnu—all might not be received.
translations.idiomatic: He then fashioned four articles: Han subjects who fled into the Xiongnu, Wusun who surrendered to the Xiongnu, Western Region states wearing Han seals and cords who surrendered to the Xiongnu, and Wuhuan who surrendered to the Xiongnu—all might not be received.

sentences.zh: 遣中郎將王駿、王昌、副校尉甄阜、王尋使匈奴，班四條與單于，雜函封，付單于，令奉行；

translations.literal: He dispatched Palace Gentlemen Wang Jun and Wang Chang, assistant commandants Zhen Fu and Wang Xun as envoys to the Xiongnu, promulgated the four articles to the Chanyu, sealed them mixed in a casket, delivered them to the Chanyu, and ordered compliance;
translations.idiomatic: He dispatched Palace Gentlemen Wang Jun and Wang Chang, assistant commandants Zhen Fu and Wang Xun as envoys to the Xiongnu, promulgated the four articles to the Chanyu, sealed them mixed in a casket, delivered them to the Chanyu, and ordered compliance;

sentences.zh: 因收故宣帝所為約束封函還。

translations.literal: and thereupon took back the sealed covenant the former Emperor Xuan had made.
translations.idiomatic: and thereupon took back the sealed covenant the former Emperor Xuan had made.

sentences.zh: 時莽奏令中國不得有二名，因使使者以風單于，宜上書慕化，為一名，漢必加厚賞。

translations.literal: At the time Mang memorialized that the Central States might not have two names; he therefore had envoys prompt the Chanyu that he ought to submit a memorial admiring transformation and take one name—Han would surely add thick rewards.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Mang memorialized that the Central States might not have two names; he therefore had envoys prompt the Chanyu that he ought to submit a memorial admiring transformation and take one name—Han would surely add rich rewards.

sentences.zh: 單于從之，上書言：「幸得備籓臣，竊樂太平聖制。

translations.literal: The Chanyu followed; his memorial said: "Fortunately able to serve as a border subject, your subject privately delights in the sagely system of great peace.
translations.idiomatic: The Chanyu followed; his memorial said, "Fortunately able to serve as a border subject, your subject privately delights in the sagely system of great peace.

sentences.zh: 臣故名囊知牙斯，今謹更名曰知。

translations.literal: Your subject's former name was Nangzhiyasi; now he respectfully changes his name to Zhi."
translations.idiomatic: Your subject's former name was Nangzhiyasi; now he respectfully changes his name to Zhi."

sentences.zh: 」莽大說，白太后，遣使者答諭，厚賞賜焉。

translations.literal: " Mang was greatly pleased; he told the Empress Dowager and dispatched envoys to reply and instruct, with rich rewards and gifts.
translations.idiomatic: " Mang was greatly pleased; he told the Empress Dowager and dispatched envoys to reply and instruct, with rich rewards and gifts.

sentences.zh: 莽欲以女配帝為皇后以固其權，奏言：「皇帝即位三年，長秋宮未建，掖廷媵未充。

translations.literal: Mang wished to marry his daughter to the emperor as empress to secure his power; he memorialized: "The emperor has been on the throne three years; the Palace of Everlasting Autumn has not been established, and the secondary consorts of the inner palace are not filled.
translations.idiomatic: Mang wished to marry his daughter to the emperor as empress to secure his power; he memorialized, "The emperor has been on the throne three years; the Palace of Everlasting Autumn has not been established, and the secondary consorts of the inner palace are not filled.

sentences.zh: 乃者國家之難，本從無嗣，配取不正，請考論《五經》，定取後禮，正十二女之義，以廣繼嗣，博采二王后及周公、孔子世、列侯在長安者適子女。

translations.literal: Recently the state's difficulty sprang fundamentally from lack of heir; the match was not correct—please examine and discuss the Five Classics, fix the ritual of taking a successor, rectify the meaning of the twelve women, to broaden continuation of the line, broadly gather eligible sons and daughters of the two kings' lines, the Zhou Duke's and Confucius's clans, and ranked marquises in Chang'an."
translations.idiomatic: Recently the state's difficulty sprang fundamentally from lack of heir; the match was not correct—please examine and discuss the Five Classics, fix the ritual of taking a successor, rectify the meaning of the twelve women, to broaden continuation of the line, and broadly gather eligible sons and daughters of the two kings' lines, the Duke of Zhou's and Confucius's clans, and ranked marquises in Chang'an."

sentences.zh: 」事下有司，上眾女名，王氏女多在選中者，莽恐其與己女爭，即上言：「身無德，子材下，不宜與眾女並采。

translations.literal: " The matter was sent to the relevant offices; the names of many women were submitted—Wang clan women were mostly among those selected; Mang feared they would compete with his daughter and immediately submitted: "This body lacks virtue; my daughter's talents are low; she is not fit to be gathered with the multitude of women."
translations.idiomatic: " The matter was sent to the relevant offices; the names of many women were submitted—Wang clan women were mostly among those selected; Mang feared they would compete with his daughter and immediately submitted, "This body lacks virtue; my daughter's talents are low; she is not fit to be gathered with the multitude of women."

sentences.zh: 」太后以為至誠，乃下詔曰：「王氏女，朕之外家，其勿采。

translations.literal: " The Empress Dowager considered this utmost sincerity; she thereupon issued an edict: "Wang clan women are Our maternal kin—let them not be gathered."
translations.idiomatic: " The Empress Dowager considered this utmost sincerity; she thereupon issued an edict: "Wang clan women are Our maternal kin—let them not be gathered."

sentences.zh: 」庶民、諸生、郎吏以上守闕上書者日千餘人，公卿大夫或詣廷中，或伏省戶下，鹹言：「安漢公盛勳堂堂若此，今當立後，獨奈何廢公女，天下安所歸命！

translations.literal: " Commoners, academicians, and gentlemen-attendants upward guarded the palace gate and submitted memorials—more than a thousand per day; excellencies, ministers, and grandees either came to the court or prostrated beneath the provincial gate, all saying: "The Duke of Anhan's magnificent merit is thus; now when he ought to establish a successor line, alone why discard the Duke's daughter—whither shall the realm turn for its mandate!
translations.idiomatic: " Commoners, academicians, and gentlemen-attendants upward guarded the palace gate and submitted memorials—more than a thousand per day; excellencies, ministers, and grandees either came to the court or prostrated beneath the provincial gate, all saying, "The Duke of Anhan's magnificent merit is thus; now when he ought to establish a successor line, alone why discard the Duke's daughter—whither shall the realm turn for its mandate!

sentences.zh: 願得公女為天下母！

translations.literal: We wish to obtain the Duke's daughter as mother of the realm!"
translations.idiomatic: We wish to obtain the Duke's daughter as mother of the realm!"

sentences.zh: 」莽遣長史以下分部曉止公卿及諸生，而上書者愈甚。

translations.literal: " Mang dispatched chief clerks and below in sections to enlighten and stop the excellencies and academicians—but those submitting memorials grew all the more.
translations.idiomatic: " Mang dispatched chief clerks and below in sections to enlighten and stop the excellencies and academicians—but those submitting memorials grew all the more.

sentences.zh: 太后不得已，聽公卿采莽女。

translations.literal: The empress dowager had no alternative and listened to the dukes and ministers to select Mang's daughter.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager had no choice but to let the chief ministers put Wang Mang's daughter back in the selection.

sentences.zh: 莽復自白：「宜博選眾女。

translations.literal: Mang again reported on his own behalf: "It is fitting broadly to select the host of girls.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang again memorialized on his own behalf: "Many girls ought to be selected broadly."

sentences.zh: 」公卿爭曰：「不宜采諸女以貳正統。

translations.literal: " The dukes and ministers contended: "It is not fitting to gather many girls so as to divide the orthodox succession.
translations.idiomatic: " The chief ministers argued: "It is not fitting to select many girls and divide the legitimate succession."

sentences.zh: 」莽乃白：「願見女。

translations.literal: " Mang then reported: "We wish to see the girl.
translations.idiomatic: " Wang Mang then memorialized: "I ask to present my daughter for viewing."
